title: Realizing Low-Precision Storage and Sparse Execution in a Folded FPGA Speech Enhancer
abstract: arXiv:2610.35144v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hardware-aware training often optimizes FPGA resources, latency, or bit operations, but folding changes what compression saves: shared arithmetic decouples precision, weight storage, and scheduled work. We derive training objectives from the measured costs of a folded streaming speech-enhancement accelerator. Mixed-precision weights reduce on-chip storage; structured channel sparsity removes entire operations from the engine schedule. We deploy a bit-exact implementation on the Kria KV260. The best sparse model eliminates 47.3% of convolution MACs, cutting frame time by 45% (1.86 to 1.03 ms) and dynamic energy by 60% (83 to 33 $\mu$J/frame) against a storage-priced model measured in the same session, with higher speech quality. Relative to the most efficient dense build measured separately, frame time falls by 42% and energy by 48%. Reducing weight width from 8 to 6 bits lowers dynamic power by 27% but changes frame time by less than 5

translated_title: 在折叠式FPGA语音增强器中实现低精度存储与稀疏执行
translated_abstract: 硬件感知训练通常旨在优化FPGA资源、延迟或位操作数，但折叠技术改变了压缩所能节省的内容：共享算术运算将精度、权重存储与调度工作量解耦。我们基于折叠式流式语音增强加速器的实测成本推导出训练目标。混合精度权重可减少片上存储占用；结构化通道稀疏性可从引擎调度中完整移除某些运算。我们在Kria KV260上部署了位精确实现。与同一测量会话中按存储计价的模型相比，最优稀疏模型消除了47.3%的卷积MAC运算，将帧时间缩短45%（从1.86毫秒降至1.03毫秒），动态能耗降低60%（从83微焦/帧降至33微焦/帧），同时语音质量更高。相对于单独测量的最高效稠密构建，帧时间降低42%，能耗降低48%。将权重位宽从8位降至6位可使动态功耗降低27%，但帧时间变化小于5%（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过硬件感知训练在折叠式FPGA语音增强加速器上结合混合精度权重与结构化通道稀疏性，消除了47.3%的卷积MAC运算，使帧时间缩短45%、动态能耗降低60%，同时提升了语音质量。
en_tdlr: Hardware-aware training combining mixed-precision weights and structured channel sparsity in a folded FPGA speech enhancer eliminates 47.3% of convolution MACs, cutting frame time by 45% and dynamic energy by 60% while improving speech quality.
